display.purpose: One hero number per screen: level, measured total, capacity, charging power.

display-unit.purpose: The unit beside a Display numeral, in text-secondary.

title.purpose: App bar and section titles, the compact onboarding title, figure-strip figures, the Timeline readout.

body.purpose: Story sentences, the verdict, descriptions, switch labels, definition lists.

data.purpose: Table and row values, the ETA line, checklist items.

data-lead.purpose: A bold lead word in a Data line; the bracket range label.

label.purpose: Column headers, chips, selection controls, list-group headings, the stepper label.

caption.purpose: Units beside small figures, row details, share percentages, chart text and captions, footnotes.

components.css: .ds-prov-key { font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0, 1fr); column-gap: 16px; row-gap: 8px; margin: 0; color: var(--text-primary, oklch(0.22 0.015 255)); } .ds-prov-key dt { display: grid; place-items: center; height: 24px; } .ds-prov-key dd { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; } .ds-prov-key strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-prov-key svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary, oklch(0.48 0.015 255)); fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; }

components.name: Bracket on a Graduated Scale
components.description: The signature: an estimate drawn as a copper bracket spanning its interval on a hairline scale; the point estimate is a tick.
components.css: .ds-scale { margin: 0; } .ds-scale svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; overflow: visible; } .ds-scale text { font: 400 12px "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; fill: var(--text-secondary, oklch(0.48 0.015 255)); } .ds-scale .ds-strong { fill: var(--text-primary, oklch(0.22 0.015 255)); font-weight: 600; } .ds-axis { stroke: var(--text-secondary, oklch(0.48 0.015 255)); stroke-width: 1; fill: none; } .ds-bracket { stroke: var(--accent, oklch(0.6 0.14 50)); stroke-width: 3; fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-tick { stroke: var(--text-primary, oklch(0.22 0.015 255)); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; }

narrative.overview:
Coulomb reads like a battery instrument. Values sit on graduated scales, and every estimate is drawn as a bracket spanning its interval, never as a point. The world refuses the category default: a ring gauge and a big percentage on a coloured card, with score tiles beneath.

The ground is cool slate, tinted to hue 255; nothing is pure grey. Hairlines divide content instead of cards. Hanken Grotesk with tabular figures sets numbers like a timetable column. Spline Sans Mono appears only for raw identifiers. One copper accent marks the reading that matters. Data hues appear only on power-component marks, each with a direct label. Every figure carries one of four drawn provenance marks.

Density is moderate: one hero per screen, then ruled rows at 72 dp. Motion is calm and critically damped, and nothing moves while the screen is idle. The personality is SPEC 11.2's: precise, calm, candid.
keyCharacteristics: The bracket on a graduated scale is the signature move: time remaining (Now), the capacity interval (Health), time to target beside the target tick (Charging).
Hairlines and space group content. Cards appear only for a movable unit (an insight, a session).
Copper is rare: the bracket, charging power and the selection.
Hue names a power component and nothing else. States use neutral ink.
Tabular, lining figures on every text style.
Every figure shows its provenance: Measured, Modeled, Estimated or Derived.

rules.name: The Hue Names a Component Rule
rules.body: A data hue means one power component. Doze, top app, signal, temperature and wear stress are states, so they use neutral ink: `text-secondary` solid or a 20% tint with a 1 dp outline.

rules.name: The Narrow Copper Rule
rules.body: Copper marks the bracket, charging power and the selection. As emphasis it appears at most once per region. Charging drawn in a chart is a data encoding and counts once per chart. Discharging uses neutral ink.

rules.name: The Chosen Value Rule
rules.body: `accent-fill` marks a chosen value: a window, a target, a filter chip, the navigation pill. A view tab, such as Drain's lens, switches views of the same data and selects with `surface-raised` and a check, in ink (ADR-0025 §2).

rules.name: The Ink on Fills Rule
rules.body: Any fill that carries text or an icon uses a fill token and its on-colour at 4.5:1 or more: `accent-fill` with `on-accent-fill`, status fills with their `on-` inks.

rules.name: The Timetable Rule
rules.body: Every text style sets `tnum` and `lnum`, not only numbers in tables (`fontFeatureSettings = "tnum,lnum"`; ADR-0022 §5, ADR-0024 §6).

rules.name: The No Fourteen Rule
rules.body: The roles above are the only sizes. 14 sp is not a role, and a new size needs a SPEC edit, not a local style.

rules.name: The Fixed Weight Rule
rules.body: Each role keeps its weight in every state. Selection never changes font weight; it shows by fill, check or indicator (ADR-0023 §3, ADR-0025 §3).

rules.name: The Unbreakable Figure Rule
rules.body: A number, its unit and its provenance mark never break apart. Prose wraps "pretty", so no word sits alone on a last line; headings balance. Names and identifiers break only between words, never mid-word.

rules.name: The Hairline, Not Card Rule
rules.body: Group with space and 1 dp hairlines. A card holds only content that moves as a unit, such as an insight or a session, and cards never nest.

rules.name: The Still Screen Rule
rules.body: Nothing animates while idle: no shimmer, pulse or loop. The live current chart redraws at most once a second. The wavy level is allowed only on Charging while plugged in.

dos: Do draw every estimate as a range: a copper bracket on its scale, and the range in text with the Estimated mark.
Do put a provenance mark on every figure, or one mark on the header of a single-source table or chart.
Do keep the verdict, the reading and its scale inside the first viewport on Now, with the hero at 30% or more.
Do end a truncated share list with a remainder row and state the denominator, so the visible rows sum to the whole.
Do label every coloured item directly, and give every chart a "View as table" alternative.
Do use one gutter per screen (16 dp compact, 24 dp medium) and 48 dp targets everywhere.
Do name the charging phase in plain words ("full speed", "slowing down near full").
Do keep a number, its unit and its mark on one line, and wrap names only between words.
donts: Don't draw a ring gauge, a big percentage on a coloured card or score tiles.
Don't set text in copper, or put text on a copper fill other than `accent-fill`.
Don't use a data hue for a state (Doze, top app, signal, temperature, wear stress).
Don't use a dot, ring, bracket or half dot as a chart marker.
Don't let a translucent fill carry meaning without a solid edge.
Don't wrap sections in cards or nest cards.
Don't add a size outside the type roles; 14 sp is not a role.
Don't change font weight to show selection.
Don't use a tonal button, or a radius outside 6, 12, 20 and 28 other than a full pill.
Don't use `text-secondary` on any coloured fill.
Don't animate while idle, bounce, or overshoot.
Don't scale chart labels with the plot, or break a word mid-word to fit a column.
labDiffers: Row names and mono text break anywhere, so "Unattributed" splits at 200%. Port: words break only between words (SPEC 11.3).
Drain's "+22" spills out of its 40 dp tile at 200%. Port: text fits its container (SPEC 11.3).
Chart labels sit in fixed SVGs and do not scale. Port: sp text, re-laid out per chart (SPEC 11.8, ADR-0022 §4).
A solid dot marks the current point on Now, Health, Charging and Timeline. Port: the line meets the "now" rule with no dot; a point estimate is a tick (SPEC 11.8, ADR-0023 §10).
Health's capacity band is a 14% copper fill with no edge. Port: a solid edge at 3:1 or better (ADR-0022 §4).
Selected navigation labels, window choices, lens tabs and the toolbar range go to weight 600. Port: weights stay fixed per role (ADR-0023 §3).
Now's "Open battery protection" is a tonal button. Port: outlined (SPEC 11.4).
The window group's inner corners are 8 dp, and App detail's icon has a 16 dp radius. Port: inner corners 6 dp; app icons as the system provides them (SPEC 11.5).
The app bar title truncates with an ellipsis. Port: it wraps to a second line (SPEC 11.3).
